story_text: As a new user, I want to create an account so I can use the product.

explicit_ACs.text: The sign up page shall collect a first name
The sign up page shall collect a last name
The sign up page shall collect an email address
The sign up page shall collect a password
The sign up page shall display a submit button

implicit_ACs.text: The sign up page shall show password requirements
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Password creation flows typically describe strength requirements

implicit_ACs.text: The sign up page shall present a terms and conditions link
implicit_ACs.inference_rationale: Registration flows commonly require legal acceptance
